1.translation: Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?

2.translation: Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[2], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.
2.footnotes: [2] A combination of male and female gametes (sperm and egg) which form the zygote after fertilization in the womb.

3.translation: Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.

4.translation: We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.

5.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[3],

6.translation: a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.

7.translation: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,

8.translation: and they give food, despite their love for it[4], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,

9.translation: [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.

10.translation: We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”

11.translation: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,

12.translation: and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.

13.translation: They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[5] nor freezing cold.

14.translation: with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.

15.translation: They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,

16.translation: crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.

17.translation: They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger

18.translation: from a spring therein called Salsabīl.

19.translation: They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

20.translation: If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.

21.translation: They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

22.translation: [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”

23.translation: Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.

24.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.

25.translation: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[6],
25.footnotes: [6] This and the next verse refer to the five daily prayers: here it refers to the dawn prayer, then the noon and afternoon prayers.

26.translation: and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[7].
26.footnotes: [7] It refers to the sunset and night prayers.

27.translation: Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.

28.translation: It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.

29.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who wills may take a way to his Lord.

30.translation: But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

31.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.
